$comment: S4 ceilings for static style counts over packages/web2/src. Checked by tools/ci/style-ratchet.mjs (tools/ci/style-ratchet.test.mjs in test:ci). A count may only go down: lower its ceiling in the commit that lowers it. fontBytes may rise only in the commit that adds a font, with the reason in the log.

$lowered.reason: round 11 merge: one AsciiSpinner (a timer while mounted) replaced the CSS-looped .s2-spin.

infiniteAnimations.what: CSS animation declarations with infinite iterations

$raised.reason: round 11: the shared .shimmer-text class (tokens/graphite.css), owner-asked text shimmer on words of something running; it loops only while the class is on a running label and is static under reduced motion.

backdropFilters.what: backdrop-filter declarations that are not none (the -webkit- twin is not counted)

$raised.reason: round 10: owner asked for translucent, blurred menus and panels this round (the glass menus and panels in the round-10 look).

fontBytes.what: bytes of bundled font files under packages/web2/src/**/fonts

heavyWeights.what: CSS weight requests of 500 or more (font-weight, font shorthand, --fw-* tokens, bold/bolder). 0 under Archivo (Decisions 41 and 44); 4 under Decision 49: the --fw-label/head/solid/verdict tokens on Inter static cuts 500/600/700.

$raised.reason: Decision 49 (reskin milestone 1): Inter is the face again with the pre-Bastion ladder, labels 500, headings and solid 600, verdicts 700, on real static cuts. The four are the four --fw-* tokens in graphite.css; no component sheet adds a weight. bytes is the count of declarations here.
